notes.text: G3 finished at 01:24 on 4 Nov and is scored: no excess of real dips over noise (cleaned-light half, bar 7: 18 real, 31 upside-down, 23.5 expected from noise). The false-alarm line still misses its mark (9.34 per 1,000 against 8), as in G2. Counts only; the scorecard is in the 4 Nov field note.
G3 is prepared and checked: 612 stars, Vesper 0.8.1 frozen, nothing has run. The search starts only on Ahmed's word.
The sealed search finished and is scored: no excess of real dips over noise. The section What the search found says what that means.
The one-time sealed search of the 594 G2 stars has started with Vesper 0.8.0. Blind run: real and upside-down dips are mixed and not labelled until the final analysis.
